_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Bamidbar 8, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then God spoke to Moses in speech.
translations.2: 'Command Aaron and say to him: when you light the lamp, toward what faces the front of the lampstand shall its seven lamps give light.'
translations.3: And so Aaron did — he lit the lamps of the lampstand toward what faces its front, as God had commanded Moses.
translations.4: And this is the workmanship of the lampstand: solid gold — even its base and its blossoms were solid — like the appearance which God had shown to Moses; so he made it.
translations.5: Then God spoke to Moses in speech.
translations.6: 'Bring forward the Levites from among the sons of Israel, and purify them.'
translations.7: 'And thus shall you do for them in their purification: sprinkle upon them of the water of purification, and let them pass a razor over all their body, and let them wash their garments — and they shall be purified.'
translations.8: 'And they shall bring forward an ox from the herd, and with it wheat-flour, fine semolina mixed with oil; and a second ox from the herd — take it for the purification-offering.'
translations.9: 'And bring forward the Levites before the tent of meeting, and assemble the congregation of the sons of Israel.'
translations.10: 'And present them before God, and the sons of Israel shall lay their hands upon them.'
translations.11: 'And Aaron shall present them as a presentation before God, from the sons of Israel — that they may be for serving the service of God.'
translations.12: 'And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bulls; and make one of them a purification-offering, and the other a burnt-offering to God, and seek forgiveness for them.'
translations.13: 'And station them before Aaron and his sons, and present them as a presentation to God.'
translations.14: 'And separate them from among the sons of Israel, and they shall be Mine.'
translations.15: 'And after that they shall enter to serve the tent of meeting — for you will have purified them and presented them as a presentation.'
translations.16: 'For they are appointed to Me from among the sons of Israel: in place of every firstborn, the opener of every womb among the sons of Israel — I have taken them for Myself.'
translations.17: 'Just as every firstborn among the sons of Israel was Mine — of human and of beast — on the day I destroyed every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated them to Me.'
translations.18: 'Thus I took the Levites in their stead.'
translations.19: 'And I appointed them for Aaron and his sons, from among the sons of Israel, to perform their service in the tent of meeting, and to seek forgiveness for them — that no pestilence may come upon them when they approach the sanctuary.'
translations.20: And Moses and Aaron, and the rest of the congregation of the sons of Israel, did for the Levites according to all that God had commanded Moses concerning them — so they did for them.
translations.21: And they were purified and washed their garments; and Aaron presented them as a presentation before God, and sought forgiveness for them and purified them.
translations.22: And after that they entered to perform their service in the tent of meeting, before Aaron and his sons — according to all that God had commanded Moses concerning them, so they did for them.
translations.23: Then God spoke to Moses in speech.
translations.24: 'This is the ordinance for the Levites: from twenty-five years of age and upward, one shall enter the host for the service of the tent of meeting.'
translations.25: 'And from fifty years of age he shall retire from it, and shall serve no more at all.'
translations.26: 'But he may serve alongside his brothers in guarding the tent of meeting; as for his former service, he shall not serve. Thus shall you do for them in their charge.'
